page.layout: Two parallel columns of index entries under the running title INDEX at the top; the left column is read first, then the right. A small mark "2" sits below the columns at right. A woodcut ornament lies in the lower middle of the page and is not text.

main_text.l: Vim non facit, qui vtitur iure

page.notes: The left-column entry "Tutoris datio, est fuorum here-" continues in the right column as "dum", so the word "heredum" runs across the column break. The "V" line at the head of the right column is a letter heading and "VAnus" begins with a large woodcut-style initial. The number in "plenior 1.12" and the "§.τ" in "suo l.155.§.τ" are as printed and may be misread; the Greek letter τ is a best reading. The woodcut ornament below the columns is left out. No page number is printed.
